guidance.promptSnippet: Track independent work, dependencies, and waiting gates with todo
promptGuidelines: Use `todo` when work spans many turns, has independent parts, or waits on something external. Work you finish in one turn needs no list.
Mark a task completed when its check passes. A task can go straight from pending to completed.
In `todo`, create adds pending tasks, and update changes status. Set blockedBy on create, and use addBlockedBy or removeBlockedBy on update.
